Immutable handle to the USDC/ETH UniswapV2Pair used for cumulative price reads.
Seeds all cumulative price and timestamp snapshots from both Uniswap pairs at deployment.
Internal view computing the average ETH/REB price since the last stored snapshot via counterfactual cumulative prices.
Internal view computing the average USDC/ETH price since the last stored snapshot via counterfactual cumulative prices.
Externally callable state refresher: rate-limits via MIN_PERIOD, rewrites all snapshots and recomputes lastAnswer.
External view oracle entrypoint: returns cached lastAnswer inside UPDATE_LAG, otherwise recomputes the answer.
Miner/validator-influenced time source used for rate limiting and lag checks.
timeElapsed = timeStamp - lastUpdateTimestamp in update(); unchecked subtraction with no SafeMath and no lower-bound on lastUpdateTimestamp.
lastAnswer = (rebEthAverage * 1e18) / usdcEthAverage in update(); unchecked multiplication and division with no zero-guard on usdcEthAverage.
answer = (rebEthAverage * 1e18) / usdcEthAverage in getData(); unchecked multiplication and division with no zero-guard.
rebEthAverage = uint224(1e9 * (price1Cumulative - ethRebPrice1CumulativeLast) / (_blockTimestamp - ethRebBlockTimestampLast)) in getRebEthRate(); unchecked subtraction and division denominator.
usdcEthAverage = uint224(1e6 * (price0Cumulative - usdcEthPrice0CumulativeLast) / (_blockTimestamp - usdcEthBlockTimestampLast)) in getUsdcEthRate(); unchecked subtraction and division denominator.
block.timestamp < lastUpdateTimestamp + UPDATE_LAG in getData(); timestamp-dependent branch selecting cached vs recomputed answer.
